items.title: 5 dead in Philippine ferry fire off Palawan with scores still missing
Hate speech against Rohingya refugees on the rise in Malaysia
items.description: Hostile social media content, disinformation campaigns, and a petition calling for their expulsion: in Malaysia, a wave of hate speech has been targeting Rohingya refugees, a Muslim minority driven out of Myanmar. The rising hostility has already led to the eviction of more than 100 people from a village and forced the…

items.title: Myanmar airport closed following reported drone attack
items.description: Military government pins attack on pro-democracy rebels it has been battling since seizing power in 2021.

items.title: How 9/11 Changed America and Tested NATO’s Article 5
items.description: The Sept. 11 attacks killed 2,977 people, transformed American security, and began two decades of war. They also provided NATO’s only test of Article 5. Allies defended US airspace and later deployed tens of thousands of troops, but each government retained control over what it contributed. That distinction remains cri…

items.title: Iran war: Saudi-Houthi escalation intensifies Yemen conflict
items.description: The Houthi takeovers of Mokha, Dhubab and Perim in the Bab el-Mandeb Strait threaten to push Yemen deeper into the Middle East war. The Iran-backed group has made advances against Yemen's government and Saudi Arabia.

items.title: 'Save Him!' RFE/RL Captures Chaos After Russian Strike On Ukrainian Shops
items.description: Ukraine’s foreign minister is urging allies to provide more air defenses after a Russian drone strike on Pavlohrad killed at least five people and injured dozens. RFE/RL correspondent Roman Pahulych arrived as emergency crews treated the wounded and battled fires.

items.title: Iran-backed Houthi rebels seize strategic Red Sea port in Yemen
items.description: The rebel group took over Yemen's port of Mokha, an area vital to controlling shipping through the Red Sea, Houthi and Yemeni officials said. Mokha is about 50 miles from the Bab el-Mandeb Strait.

items.title: Trump, 'non ho rimpianti sulla guerra all'Iran ma talvolta mi faccio domande'
Why Saudi Arabia and the Houthis in Yemen are heading toward war
items.description: The Iranian-backed Houthis in Yemen are stepping up attacks against their enemies at home and abroad.

items.title: More than 20 children killed in DR Congo school fire
items.description: Officials say there was a stampede as they fled a fire that engulfed two schools in the eastern rebel-held city of Bukavu.

items.title: French government threatens CNews with sanctions if Russian propagandist returns on air
items.description: Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez said the channel owned by billionaire Vincent Bolloré was 'circumventing' the deportation order of Xenia Fedorova and 'facilitating' Russian interference.

items.title: Ukraine: Drone attacks on Chornobyl are ‘gambling with the safety of millions of people’
items.description: A drone strike on the protective structure at the Chornobyl Nuclear Power Plant could have endangered the safety of millions of people, UN Development Programme (UNDP) Administrator Alexander De Croo told reporters via video link from Kyiv on Thursday.

items.title: Tens of millions of people fail to get humanitarian aid as global system crumbles
items.description: Funding cuts in 2025 left women, children, older and displaced people hard hit, with 64m fewer people receiving aidThe humanitarian aid system is crumbling as funding shrinks, pressures increase and governments not only fail to protect civilians but are increasingly responsible for endangering them, a new report warned…

items.title: 4 Killed in Ukrainian Attack on Novorossiysk
items.description: Russian officials said more than two dozen people were wounded during the overnight attack on the port city.
